Fighting in Flanders
exhibition inside the Civic Centre.  The travelling exhibition from the Canadian War Museum shares Canada's important role during the First World War through historical photographs and personal stories.  It will be on display until November 14th.
Mayor Meloche reminded residents that the Inaugural Meeting of the newly elected Council will take place on Tuesday, November 17 at 6 p.m. at Town Hall.  The ceremony is open to the public and the Mayor encouraged anyone interested to attend as we welcome the new Council and the beginning of the next four-year term.

Questions and Statements by Council Members
Joe Milicia, Chief Administrative Officer, thanked Mayor Meloche and outgoing members of Council on behalf of Administration, Council and the Town.  Mr. Milicia highlighted the legacy Mayor Meloche has left with being the first female Mayor in LaSalle, inspiring women to break through those glass ceilings and also her legacy of principled, collaborative and responsive leadership.
